claims: s(12) >= 31360/7901 = 3.96911783..., by Evan Daniel's 1,736-point weighted certificate s12/certificates/s12_lower_3.9686.txt (evand/square-packing 7d6f46d9) with every coordinate and the container multiplied by 7902/7901 and the weights unchanged, total 119738036/10^7 < 12 (s12_lower_3.969118.txt, README.md)

Daniel's verify at 7d6f46d rejects the rescaled certificate on the angle nets N = 6000 (least 9849809/10^7) and 12000 (9867834/10^7) and verifies it at N = 24000 (10000056/10^7), also when rebuilt with overflow checks (logs/daniel_verify_*.log)

tools/indep_check.cpp, written from the statement and sweeping [0, 90] degrees with no symmetry assumed, agrees on every net and also verifies at N = 48000 and 96000; the certificate scaled to 31360/7900 is rejected at N = 24000 (logs/indep_check_*.log, logs/control_*.log)
